name: WX Scroll To Up
author: Md Sahidul Islam

sections.description:
WX Scroll To Up is a clean, user-friendly plugin that adds a scroll-to-top button to your WordPress website — improving navigation and enhancing user experience, especially on long pages.

Customize the button’s design, position, color, size, and icon style (Flaticon or your own SVG). Smooth scroll animations and a lightweight footprint make it a perfect fit for any theme.

Key Features:

  • Multiple button designs
  • Choose from Flaticon icons or upload a custom SVG
  • Set button position (left, right, or center)
  • Customize colors, size, and border radius
  • Smooth scroll animation
  • Lightweight and responsive

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wx-scroll-to-up folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → WX Scroll To Up to configure your button styles and options.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the button appearance?

Yes — the plugin settings allow you to adjust icon, size, color, border radius, position, and upload your own SVG if you prefer.

Is the button mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The button is responsive and works seamlessly on all screen sizes and devices.

How do I reset the button to default settings?

Simply remove or adjust your saved settings from the plugin options page and save the changes.
